fig1_exposure.panel_a: historical exposure audit D90+Cap180 (an earlier, different repair study on pvlib): offered = completed model requests whose tool list held the tool; requested, executed and visible count tool calls or results. Motivation only, not corroboration of Exp A.
fig1_exposure.panel_b: Exp A block T (seed 11; role exploratory in ANALYSIS.json): requested and C* recovered from ANALYSIS.json secondary.t_block; non-empty answer visible and submitted from EXPLORE.json section 7 (exploratory). Bars are family-weighted shares (equal to k/n here); whiskers are 95% t intervals over 30 families (marginal); a zero-variance interval is not drawn. The stages are not nested: submission does not require a graph answer.

fig2_outcomes.description: Block P, seeds 11/23/47, 2,250 episodes per condition. Segments: submitted and C* listed, submitted and C* not listed, budget exhausted (NoAnswer). No ContextLimit, FormatExhausted or other exit occurred. Point and whisker: family-weighted C* recovery with its 95% t interval (marginal). Lines: model-free reference policies on the frozen items (references, not ceilings). The listed/not-listed split is bookkeeping, not mediation.

fig3_contrasts.description: Confirmatory H1-H3 on block P: estimate and 95% t interval (marginal) over 30 families, the 30 family mean differences as dots, dashed lines at the prespecified practically meaningful effect, Holm-adjusted p over H1-H3 only. Inference is benchmark-conditional on the frozen family set.

fig4_timeline.description: Exploratory (post-results) TIMELINE.json, block P: family-weighted share of episodes submitted by response k and share with the C* site visible by response k under the LOOSE rule (can overcount; STRICT is the lower bound), 95% t bands (marginal); vertical line at the 8-response cap. Descriptive; no causal or mediation reading.
